info.title: TableTap API
info.description:
Multi-tenant restaurant QR ordering platform.

* `/api/v1/public/**` — customer storefront & checkout (no auth, scoped by table QR token)
* `/api/v1/restaurant/**` — restaurant dashboard (JWT, OWNER/STAFF, tenant from token)
* `/api/v1/admin/**` — platform admin (JWT, PLATFORM_ADMIN)
* `/api/v1/webhooks/**` — payment provider callbacks (signature-verified)

Obtain a token via `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (demo password: `demo1234`).

delete.summary: Remove a table (soft delete; order history is kept)

Merchant account (Razorpay) connection — secrets are never returned

Edit a menu item (name, price, category, image, …)

post.summary: Receive a payment event (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body in X-Razorpay-Signature)

get.summary: List tables with their QR ordering URLs

post.summary: Create a table (a QR token is generated automatically)
